review_evidence: README describes a formal social-choice/apportionment library.
Apportionmentlib/Basic.lean defines elections/rules and formal apportionment properties and theorems; Utils and PlausibleInstances support that formal development.
Only formal library files are primary; Lake metadata is already excluded by the baseline filter.
summary: Retain apportionmentlib: its four primary Lean files formalize elections, apportionment rules, axioms, Balinski–Young-style results, utilities, and plausible instances.
